review_scope: One combined fresh review; all 17 GUI IDs assessed against pinned 3f source, original assembly and the original raw native evidence.

checks.name: archive_identity
checks.detail: originals.zip SHA f0e755289891f9e4914a97b368688e16cf434ca935d692ad3a7a50cca751c1d8; exact set of all 228 members, member lengths and member SHA-256 values match ARCHIVE.json.

checks.name: original_raw_inspection
checks.detail: All 48 original 1280x720 top-down BMPs were viewed individually, not only contact sheets. Mutable raw frame hashes also match the preserved archive. Raw game log has 219523 logical lines; every phase snapshot hash, alias triplet and frame ACK index was verified against original bytes.

checks.name: pinned_source_original_executable
checks.detail: All 19 source blob identities match published B5 3f4f9c06; all 29 per-site original export hashes and all ORIGINAL_PINS entries match. Source review used Git blobs, preserving unrelated WIP. The clean artifact executable currently hashes to 39b62961b59261ac8e1b9894d5a69c8ab365bf7ea39e89793d654fcf93ca47da.

checks.name: fixture_and_normal_protection
checks.detail: The retained private gate has 5 Road Rules, rank 5, 202 medals, 120 events, 85 max cars and the pinned returning-save identity. The retained before/after normal profile/config hashes and all 15 payload hashes agree; this review did not lock or re-read live normal user data.

checks.name: aggregate_terminal_outcome
checks.detail: The aggregate remains FAIL, including the failed original strict terminal outcome, one assertion and missing terminal variable restore. Existing adapter/path/capture retry failures are not promoted to behavior evidence.

findings.title: The aggregate failed at Car Select and has no terminal variable-restore pass
findings.detail: One retained assertion is mCarSelectManager.IsInJunkyard(); first_assert_stop=true, owned cleanup completed, driver status=fail and terminal_restore_verified=false. The complete original runtime chain for that assertion has not been adjudicated. G04 remains pending, not original no-op/crash-equivalent.

findings.title: CrashNav has a positive transition but an incomplete HUD restore witness
findings.detail: Both map frames show the original MAP_MAIN-style map; the exact slot Stop input returns the same world/camera/car. The pre-G13 frame already lacks the HUD. The return therefore cannot certify restoration of the natural HUD or the shutdown/restore portion of this site.

findings.title: Invite timeout does not restore the visible baseline
findings.detail: Linus T invite text is directly visible, but the envelope/D-pad icon persists after text timeout and in later frames. Original timeline evidence is needed to determine its intended lifetime and to complete the restoration verdict.

findings.title: Queued video requests must not be described as executed Intro/video evidence
findings.detail: Requests 049/050 are Car Select; 051/052 are video_trigger/video_visible. There is no Intro request. There are no 049-052 done receipts or frames. Keep both Intro and movie controls pending.

controls.caption: Trigger Car Select
controls.reason: Car Select emitted its request and reached the retained host assertion, without a captured target screen or return. The original-named assertion alone does not prove original crashing behavior.

controls.caption: Trigger Intro
controls.reason: No Intro phase or native Intro destination/return exists. The retained queued requests 051/052 are video_trigger/video_visible, not Intro.

controls.caption: Trigger crash nav
controls.reason: The map opens and the owned Stop channel returns to the world scene, but the required HUD-baseline restoration is not proved. The natural baseline has the minimap/boost HUD; the return does not. HUD was already absent before G13, so attribution of that loss is unresolved. Accept the positive map/return observation only, without full site credit.

controls.caption: Change Font Spacing
controls.reason: Font-spacing commands and new text triggers ran, but the 80/100/160 captures do not isolate the required changing text bounds or a verified rendering consumer.

controls.caption: Spacing percentage:
controls.reason: Fresh 80.000/100.000/160.000/100.000 field triplets exist; the coupled font-layout effect remains unproved.

controls.caption: Update Flash
controls.reason: TRUE/FALSE/TRUE field receipts exist. The selected notification is already disappearing/absent around the freeze captures; these stills do not prove a live APT animation stopped and resumed.

controls.caption: Show Keyboard
controls.reason: Accept the original callback argument route and the PC keyboard open/cancel path: owned HWND/PID/start/image, exact Title Text / Description Text / Default Text, owned WM_CLOSE using the provider Cancel branch, and native KeyboardHost cancellation. The fixture released only its own Brake/HandBrake holds.
limitations: PC platform UI/status path only; no XAM layout/status equivalence or hardware-controller claim.
WM_CLOSE exercised the existing Cancel/X branch; no entered text or OK acceptance was tested.
No game-backbuffer BMP can show the separate Win32 keyboard dialog; its direct native witness is the owned HWND/control census.
Full HUD/gameplay recovery after keyboard cancellation was not proved; HUD is absent in keyboard_closed.

controls.caption: Play/stop test movie
controls.reason: Video requests 051/052 are retained without done receipts, a video frame, or a return; they were queued after the failure.

controls.caption: Select next font effect
controls.reason: Five requests ran, but the invite text frames do not demonstrate distinct font effects or the effect-0 rendering restoration.

controls.caption: Trigger PFX Hook <dynamic>
controls.reason: The selected named menu-hook requests ran. The inspected raw frames do not isolate the required menu-hook effect, alternate effect and restored visual baseline.

controls.caption: Current Hook
controls.reason: Fresh hook-index changes and named aliases are field/selection evidence; the coupled original menu-hook rendering effect remains unproved.

controls.caption: Trigger PFX CloseMenu
controls.reason: CloseMenu requests exist, but there is no demonstrated active menu-hook effect that these frames prove was stopped.

controls.caption: Trigger EA Trax Component
controls.reason: Accept the event-502 song-0 preview notification: no chyron at the natural baseline, LCD Soundsystem / Us V. Them / Sound Of Silver after the exact callback, and no chyron after the normal timeout. This covers the test notification, with no audio or profile-selection claim.

controls.caption: Trigger Receive Online Invite
controls.reason: The local Linus T invite text appears and times out, but invite_closed retains the envelope/D-pad icon absent from the natural baseline. Its intended original lifetime and complete restoration need original timeline/consumer evidence.

controls.caption: Trigger Payback Component
controls.reason: The callback request ran without a visible award animation. An active RaceMainHud/Payback consumer is not established by this Freeburn scene.

controls.caption: Enable Toggling Race HUD
controls.reason: The master field TRUE/FALSE receipts exist; the boost HUD was already absent before these phases, so the required master-gate pixel effect is unproved.

controls.caption: Race HUD element toggle registration loop
controls.reason: The selected BOOST_BAR loop item has fresh FALSE/TRUE receipts. Its required visible hide/show/restore effect is not present; the other 20 loop labels receive no inferred credit.

limits: No full GUI17 completion is certified.
Keyboard acceptance is bounded to original arguments and the native PC open/cancel path; no physical controller, XAM parity, text acceptance or full HUD recovery claim.
EA Trax acceptance is bounded to the local preview notification and timeout; no audio or profile-write claim.
CrashNav and invite have positive observations but incomplete restoration outcomes.
All other controls remain pending; lack of pixels or a missing consumer does not prove an original no-op.
